topics.title: Nepal: constitution and government

lessons.title: Nepal at a glance
lessons.objective: Know the basics of Nepal's federal structure and central bank.

activities.title: A federal republic
activities.body: The Constitution of Nepal was promulgated in 2015 (2072 BS). It made Nepal a federal democratic republic with three levels of government: federal, provincial and local.

activities.title: The central bank
activities.body: Nepal Rastra Bank, established in 1956, is the central bank. It issues the Nepalese rupee and sets the country's monetary policy.

activities.prompt: How many local levels does Nepal have?
activities.explanation: There are 753 local levels: metropolitan and sub-metropolitan cities, municipalities and rural municipalities.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the central bank, issues the Nepalese rupee.

activities.prompt: In which year was the current Constitution of Nepal promulgated?
activities.explanation: The Constitution of Nepal was promulgated in 2015 (2072 BS).

questions.prompt: How many districts does Nepal have?
questions.explanation: Nepal has 77 districts across its seven provinces.

questions.prompt: In which year was Nepal Rastra Bank established?
questions.explanation: Nepal Rastra Bank was established in 1956.

questions.prompt: How many levels of government does Nepal's federal system have?
questions.explanation: Federal, provincial and local: three levels of government.
